_comment: Astro AI brain: every free model platform. No secrets here. Keyless platforms work at once; the others turn on when their key exists (Settings → Providers, a Supabase secret, or an env var with the name in "key"). Order = Auto order. Generated by tools/build_providers.js from the public FreeLLMAPI catalog 2026.10.25 plus hand-verified entries.

providers.name: OpenCode free
providers.limits: Daily free cap (resets 00:00 UTC), free for a limited time
providers.privacy: Zero-retention providers for these two models

providers.name: Groq
providers.limits: 30 requests/min, 1000 requests/day (free tier)
providers.privacy: Not used for training

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.limits: 15 requests/min, 20 requests/day (free tier)
providers.privacy: Free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products (outside the EU/UK)

providers.limits: Free tier with daily token caps; sign-up may ask for a card
providers.privacy: Check the provider’s terms before sending private data
